paraphrase: Any app with financial features must complete the Financial features declaration in Play Console and comply with the financial regulations of every region it targets; binary options trading is banned. Personal-loan apps (direct lenders, lead generators and connectors) must be in the Finance category and disclose in the listing the minimum and maximum repayment period, the maximum APR, a representative total-cost example and a comprehensive privacy policy; loans requiring full repayment in 60 days or less are banned; in the United States loans at 36% APR or higher are banned and the APR must follow TILA. Earned-wage-access apps have parallel Finance-category and disclosure duties. Loan, credit, loan-accessory and EWA apps may not access sensitive data and may not hold READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_CONTACTS, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, READ_PHONE_NUMBERS, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES or WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. Google must be able to link the developer account to any licence, and India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Nigeria, Kenya, Pakistan and Thailand each carry extra licensing and disclosure requirements.
quote: Any app that contains any financial features must complete the Financial features declaration form within Play Console.
